async def act(page):
    # Ensure the page is fully loaded
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Wait for the 'New issue' link to be visible and enabled
    new_issue_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='New issue')
    await new_issue_link.wait_for(state='visible')
    await new_issue_link.wait_for(state='enabled')
    # Click on the 'New issue' link to go to the new issue creation page
    await new_issue_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
